# Source of `strings-excerpt.xml`

- Project: the open-source Wikipedia Android app, https://github.com/wikimedia/apps-android-wikipedia
- File: `app/src/main/res/values/strings.xml`, commit `b39e649981a97d8e24eb938f04ccc3d20aa3b456`
- Licence: Apache License, Version 2.0 (`LICENSE` in this folder is the project's own `COPYING` file; the project has no NOTICE file)
- What is here: an unmodified excerpt, its "Onboarding" (23 strings) and "Shareable reading lists" (10 strings) sections, used as test input in the demo video and two stills (`video/stills/01-receipt.png`, `video/stills/03-languages-privacy.png`). The only change is the file's opening and closing lines (`<?xml …?>`, `<resources>`), added so the excerpt is a valid strings file.

Sample run: strings from the Wikipedia Android app (Apache License 2.0), used under its licence; the Wikipedia Android app is not affiliated with this project. Wikimedia does not endorse this project.
